title: Can the condensate food chain hold a standing predator population whose droplets divide? Predators that saturate (type II) or interfere, or a prey refuge, against the one-epidemic outcome
summary: In 20261026T0413-c36-food-chain-predation-claim (established IXD, prey side) predators always go extinct after one predation epidemic: last alive t=2800-9100 on 6 seeds at 256^2 and 2800-6400 at 384^2 (20261026T0543-c36-food-chain-arena-negative). 21 parameter sets screened (k2 0.12-3, kq 0.001-0.02, k0 0-0.006, prey dilute level e 0.1-0.5, chi 0.3-3; this question's chi2_screen.png: chi 2 does not stop contact predation) gave three outcomes only: predators starve, predators eat every prey, or (k0 0.006) predator material becomes a continuous phase. Predator droplets are individuals (median life 700-900 t) but never divide persistently. The missing ingredient is a self-limitation of predation that keeps the predation front from overshooting.
experiment: Use the claim's world.py (WORLD_P). Arm 1: a saturating response, already coded as Ksat (eat = k2 ca cb^2 / (1 + ca/Ksat)): Ksat 0.05-0.2 with k2 1-3 and kq 0.002-0.004 (at 128^2 Ksat 0.1 with k2 1 starved predators, so raise k2). Arm 2: predator interference: replace cb^2 by cb^2/(1 + cb^2/B) or add a crowding decay kq (1 + cb_local) so that a large predator droplet cannot eat faster than it can starve at its core, which also gives the Zwicker division route for predators. Arm 3: a prey refuge, e.g. predator mobility M_b lowered 3-10x so that predator fronts move slower than prey regrowth. 256^2, 2 seeds, t=10000 (about 10 min per run at OMP 2). Success: predators alive at t=10000 on both seeds, predator persistent splits >= 2 generations (labkit species predator), and the predator-free twin (pred_on 0) for the prey side.
